slots.usage: Riverside reeds object, bottom centre on its semantic footprint; also reused in presentation-only shore clusters.
slots.brief: A tall clump of riverbank reeds and cattails, a few brown seed heads, two or three arching leaves; reads as a natural fence beside the water.

slots.usage: Riverside forage node for hen-of-the-woods mushrooms (1 tile), while it can be gathered. Bottom-centre on the tile's lower edge.
slots.brief: A short mossy stump with a frilly cluster of hen-of-the-woods (maitake) mushrooms, grey-brown fronds with cream edges; inviting, clearly edible.

slots.usage: The same node after gathering, until it regrows. Must line up with forage.riverside-hen-of-the-woods (same stump, same pivot).
slots.brief: The same mossy stump with the mushrooms gone, a little moss and a sprout.

slots.usage: Farm forage node for rock salt (1 tile, east of the garden), while it can be gathered.
slots.brief: A low grey-green rock outcrop with white salt crystals growing from its top; slightly sparkly.

slots.usage: The rock salt outcrop after gathering. Same rock and pivot as forage.farm-rock-salt.
slots.brief: The same outcrop with the crystals chipped away, a few pale scars.

slots.usage: Ground item: the wild mint Mara wants for supper, lying on the Riverside bank until picked up.
slots.brief: A fresh sprig of wild mint, bright serrated leaves on a single stem, lying in the grass.

slots.usage: Ground item: the turnip soup recipe card beside the bed at home.
slots.brief: A small cream recipe card with handwriting and a red wax seal, lying slightly askew.

slots.usage: Presentation-only prop at the riverside.elias-bench anchor, drawn behind whoever sits there. About 2 tiles wide.
slots.brief: A weathered wooden park bench with a slatted back, a little moss on the legs; quiet and inviting.

slots.usage: Elias's walk sheet, same layout as Assets/GateA/gardener.png: rows face down, up, left, right; four walk frames per row; feet at the bottom of each 64 px cell.
slots.brief: Elias, an older riverside scholar: grey-blond hair, blue-grey coat, a satchel of books; gentle and absent-minded. Match the gardener sheet's proportions and style.

slots.usage: Sela's walk sheet, same layout as Assets/GateA/gardener.png (rows down, up, left, right; four frames each).
slots.brief: Sela, the village shopkeeper: dark hair in a bun, brick-red dress with a cream apron; brisk and friendly. Match the gardener sheet's proportions and style.
